visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up shot of a purple and pink mineral specimen, identified as fluorite, mounted on a small metal stand. The specimen is multifaceted with crystalline structures. The background is a dark, matte studio setting, and the lighting is warm and directional, highlighting the crystal's facets. Large yellow and white text overlays are positioned at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The camera moves to an extreme close-up, focusing on the rough, translucent surface of the mineral. The lighting remains warm, showing the internal variations in color and texture. (3) The scene transitions as the visible lighting is replaced by ultraviolet (UV) light. The mineral crystal now glows a deep, vibrant violet-purple. Tiny, scattered white points of light appear within the crystal, resembling a starry sky. (4) A closer view of the glowing mineral reveals the density of the internal 'stars' or oil inclusions. The surrounding environment remains black. (5) The shot widens back to a full view of the glowing specimen on its stand under UV light, with social media handles and channel titles appearing as text overlays.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你有所不知的星空油膽螢石. [Slogan]: 星期天的螢礦礦物圖鑑 星空油膽螢石 (產地: 中國新疆) 星期天配音是對的. [Subtitle]: 你現在看到的. (2) [Subtitle]: 是一種特殊的螢光礦物 星空油膽螢石. (3) [Subtitle]: 在可見光下 看似只是灰紫色的螢石晶體. (4) [Subtitle]: 用紫外線照射卻會發出閃耀的星光. (5) [Subtitle]: 這還真不可思議. (6) [Subtitle]: 這是因為螢石內部 含有大量微小的有機物油膽. (7) [Subtitle]: 油膽也分成有膽和沒膽的油膽. (8) [Subtitle]: 有膽的油膽 通常在可見光下就能被發現. (9) [Subtitle]: 沒膽的油膽 要等紫外線一照才會出現. (10) [Subtitle]: 這種比較沒膽的油膽 集結在內的礦石結晶 也被學者稱為星空膽結石. (11) [Subtitle]: 星期天的螢光礦物圖鑑 我們下回見.
